Position Overview:

Finning Canada is hiring a Permanent, Full-time Senior Director, Commercial Finance & Performance Management (CFPM), based in either Edmonton or Calgary.

Reporting to the Vice President, Finance & Supply Chain, this role represents one of the most senior and influential finance leadership positions within Finning Canada. As the senior commercial finance leader for a ~$6B revenue business, the Senior Director, CFPM plays a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, optimizing capital deployment, and strengthening commercial governance across the organization. Partnering closely with Canadian Operations, this leader oversees the Commercial & Financial Business Partnering team and serves as a trusted advisor to senior and executive leadership, translating strategy into actionable financial insight.

Leading a high-performing team of finance leaders, the role champions strong commercial acumen, best-in-class budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning, and delivers insightful financial and operational reporting to enable data-driven decision-making and effective performance management. With significant exposure to the Canadian leadership team and the broader Finning Executive, this role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact initiatives, influence enterprise-wide strategy, and shape the financial future of the business. Positioned as a key succession role to the VP, Finance & Supply Chain, this role provides a clear pathway to broader executive accountability and long-term leadership growth within Finning.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platform, Web & eCommerce
jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Director, Digital Experience Platform, Web & ECommerce

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms, Web & eCommerce provides senior leadership for Four Seasons’ web and eCommerce digital platforms, overseeing platform engineering, platform management, DevOps, release quality, compliance, and security operations.

The role balances strategic platform ownership with hands-on team leadership, ensuring that digital platforms, including FourSeasons.com, microsites, eCommerce, and related digital properties, operate with excellence, stability, and continuous improvement.

The Director partners closely with Brand & Marketing Technologies, Hotel Digital Operations, Digital Analytics, Quality Assurance, and the broader Technology Innovation & Data organization.

The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, technically curious, and comfortable working with both business users and developers.

What You’ll Be Doing

Platform Leadership & Strategy

Provide strategic direction and oversight for all web-based digital experience platforms, including FourSeasons.com, eCommerce platforms, and microsites.
Manage platform roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and delivery standards across web and eCommerce to ensure alignment with project delivery and other company initiatives.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align platform investments with business objectives, ensuring platforms support luxury guest experience goals.
Lead vendor relationship management and technology evaluations (e.g., platform providers, CDN partners, analytics and monitoring tools).
Establish success measures for AI-enabled capabilities, including guest adoption, conversion, content efficiency, service quality, operational performance, and risk indicators.
Evaluate when to build, buy, configure, or integrate AI capabilities, ensuring decisions align with enterprise architecture, data, security, privacy, and procurement standards.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers and platform management analysts.
Establish clear goals, expectations, and performance frameworks aligned to Four Seasons career progression models.
Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Manage hiring processes, including role definition, interviews, and onboarding for platform-focused roles.
Develop and coach technical leaders, establishing clear ownership, succession planning, talent development, and career growth strategies.

Platform Engineering & Operations

Oversee platform engineering practices including monitoring, alerting, infrastructure oversight, and release coordination.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, integration patterns, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, and AI/LLM Ops practices.
Ensure robust observability across web platforms using tools such as Elastic, Dynatrace, and Adobe Analytics.
Govern platform release cycles, change advisory board (CAB) processes, and production deployment standards.
Drive incident management, escalation handling, and SLA compliance across all web platforms.
Oversee the integration and operational readiness of AI services within digital platforms, including APIs, data flows, observability, performance, resilience, cost management, fallback behaviours, and incident response.
Ensure AI-enabled production capabilities are appropriately tested and monitored for availability, latency, output quality, unexpected behaviour, security events, and changes introduced by vendors or underlying models.
Support the responsible use of AI-assisted engineering, testing, documentation, observability, and incident analysis tools, with appropriate review and secure software delivery controls.
Experience delivering AI-enabled products, intelligent automation solutions, and data-driven digital experiences across DXT domains including CRM, marketing, e-commerce, loyalty, customer service, and digital experience platforms.

Platform Management & Compliance

Oversee the management and compliance of digital microsites and specialized platform properties, including sites supporting property functions.
Lead platform security reviews, vulnerability assessments (including CVE triage), PCI DSS compliance, and accessibility (WCAG) remediation efforts.
Manage platform vendor relationships related to infrastructure and compliance tooling (including, AWS, ObservePoint, Akamai, Alibaba).
Coordinate platform transitions and retirement, migration, and lifecycle activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Digital team to support business roadmap.
Partner with Mobile, QA, Analytics, and CI/CD teams to deliver consistent cross-platform standards.
Support eCommerce platform initiatives including enhancing shopping cart and booking flows, digital profile capabilities and white-label site deployments.
Experience integrating enterprise platforms and business systems including Salesforce, Oracle, marketing technologies, data platforms, and third-party SaaS solutions.
Represent the platform team in leadership forums, technology governance bodies, and cross-functional planning cycles.
Collaborate with Brand, Content, Marketing, Hotel Operations, Legal, Privacy, Security, and Digital teams to define acceptable AI use cases, guest experience standards, human review requirements, and escalation paths.
Represent web and eCommerce platform requirements in enterprise AI governance, architecture, investment, and prioritization forums.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Digital Product Management, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in digital platform management, platform engineering, or digital product leadership roles.
Proven track record leading high-performing technical teams, including Platform Owners, Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, SRE, QA, DevOps, and vendor resources.
Expert in building and operating enterprise-scale technology platforms in cloud-first environments, including application development, reliability engineering, observability, performance optimization, and operational excellence.
Proven experience leading the strategy, delivery, and operation of platforms supporting guest-facing digital experiences, e-commerce capabilities, digital compliance requirements (accessibility, security, PCI DSS), and commercial business functions.
Experience translating AI opportunities into prioritized use cases, business cases, implementation roadmaps, and measurable outcomes, with appropriate consideration for data readiness, privacy, security, intellectual property, responsible AI, and organizational change.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders and influence at a senior level.
Experience in luxury hospitality, travel, or another guest-centric digital environment is an asset.
Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
Certifications considered an asset: ITIL 4; AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps certifications; PMP; CISSP or CISM; TOGAF; or equivalent certifications in digital platform leadership, cloud operations, security, privacy, enterprise architecture, strategic planning, organizational leadership, or people management. Executive leadership or strategy certificates from institutions such as Rotman, Ivey, or Kellogg are also considered assets.
Deep understanding of enterprise web platforms, eCommerce ecosystems, and digital experience technologies.
Knowledge of CMS, DAM, personalization, search, content delivery, and customer journey platforms.
Experience managing large-scale, customer-facing digital platforms with high availability and performance requirements.
Understanding of digital product management, platform roadmaps, and lifecycle management.
Strong understanding of modern cloud-based web architectures, APIs, microservices, headless and composable platform concepts.
Deep knowledge of front-end and back-end technology ecosystems and integration patterns.
Familiarity with CDN technologies, web performance optimization, caching strategies, and global content delivery.
Understanding of system architecture, scalability, resilience, and platform modernization approaches.
Knowledge of application security practices and secure software delivery principles.
Understanding of privacy regulations and digital compliance requirements.
Incident management, problem management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning
Vendor management, technology evaluation, and enterprise platform governance.
Working knowledge of prompt design and AI evaluation techniques, with an understanding that production solutions require structured testing, governance, monitoring, and human oversight beyond prompt development.
Working knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and tools including Jira, Confluence, and Monday.com.

Key Skills/Who You Are

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Identifies emerging trends, risks, and opportunities to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
Builds, inspires, and develops high-performing teams.
Creates an inclusive and psychologically safe environment where team members can thrive.
Holds individuals and teams accountable while providing support and guidance.
Builds strong relationships across business and technology functions.
Influences decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
Effectively navigates competing priorities and stakeholder interests.
Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.
Leads organizational change associated with AI adoption, including role clarity, capability development, new workflows, and responsible-use expectations.
Makes sound decisions in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments.
Maintains focus on quality, operational excellence, and measurable business results.
Helps others understand and embrace change by providing context and direction.

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing
Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth
Drive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomes
Define Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomes
Drive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programs
Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes
Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight
Drive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teams
Demonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectiveness
Strong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environments
Experience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioning
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendations
Proven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teams
Demonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisions
Ability to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impact
BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entreprise
Diriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talents
Favoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affaires
Définir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clients
Optimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmes
Établir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affaires
Faire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriée
Favoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèle
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou dispersées
Une expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketing
Une solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affaires
Une expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA
Capacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètes
Capacité avérée à communiquer avec des intervenants de haut niveau non spécialisés dans le domaine technique et à les influencer, tout en établissant des partenariats solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML, de technologie marketing et d’autres équipes techniques

jobs.description:
About The ALDO Group

Specializing in stylish and accessible footwear, handbags, and accessories, the ALDO Group has been around for more than 50 years. With over 1,500 stores in more than 100 countries, we operate under two signature brands, ALDO and Call It Spring, and we are the core footwear partner for Sperry in North America. The ALDO Group is also an industry-recognized wholesale licensed partner, specializing in the design, sourcing, and distribution of fashion footwear, handbags, and accessories. Our diverse portfolio includes household brands such as ROXY, Brooks Brothers, Ted Baker, Hunter, and G.H.BASS. In addition to our head office in Montreal, the ALDO Group maintains international offices in Europe and Asia. For more information, visit www.aldogroup.com.

Enjoy meaningful recognition, flexible work options, great on‑site perks, generous discounts, and the pride of being part of a brand that leads with people, the planet, and its partners at heart.

Overview

The Account Director, Franchise Markets is responsible for the overall business performance, growth strategy, and profitability of ALDO Group’s franchise business across international markets. The role partners closely with franchise owners, CEOs, and senior leadership teams to drive revenue growth, margin improvement, market expansion, and long-term brand success while ensuring alignment with ALDO Group’s commercial and brand objectives.

This role leads the Account Management team and works cross-functionally with Product Development, Merchandising, Planning, Retail Buying, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance to optimize business and product performance.
